title: The Power of Connectors
text:
Linking words help readers follow the logic of a text. Words such as however, therefore, and moreover show how one idea connects to another. Without them, a text can feel like a list of unrelated facts. Good writers choose these connectors carefully.

For example, however signals a contrast, while therefore signals a result. Writers who use connectors well make their arguments easier to follow. Students, however, often overuse simple words like and and but. This habit makes their writing sound flat and repetitive.

questions.text: According to the first paragraph, what do linking words show?
options: How ideas connect to each other

questions.text: According to the second paragraph, what does 'therefore' signal?
Why might a text without linking words be hard to follow?
options: Its ideas seem unrelated to each other
It uses too many long words
It is written in the past tense

questions.text: What can be inferred about students who overuse 'and' and 'but'?
options: Their writing could be clearer and more varied
They are writing in a different language
They never use connectors at all

vocabulary.definition: joins two things together or shows a relationship between them
a clear difference between two things
for that reason; as a result
to use something too often or too much

paragraph_translations: Сполучні слова допомагають читачам стежити за логікою тексту. Слова на кшталт «however», «therefore» і «moreover» показують, як одна ідея пов'язана з іншою. Без них текст може здаватися списком не пов'язаних між собою фактів. Добрі автори ретельно обирають такі сполучники.

Наприклад, «however» сигналізує про контраст, а «therefore» про результат. Автори, які добре використовують сполучники, роблять свої аргументи легшими для розуміння. Проте студенти часто надмірно вживають прості слова на кшталт «and» і «but». Ця звичка робить їхній текст блідим і повторюваним.
